sentences.japanese: 休暇中、姉と私は富士山の麓にある小さな村に滞在した。
sentences.english: During the vacation my sister and I stayed at a small village at the foot of Mt. Fuji.

sentences.japanese: 丘の麓に白い建物が見えますね。
sentences.english: You see a white building at the foot of the hill.

sentences.japanese: 紀元前776年、最初のオリンピック競技大会は、ギリシャ人の主神ゼウスを称えるため、オリンポス山の麓で開催された。
sentences.english: In 776 B.C., the first Olympic Games were held at the foot of Mount Olympus to honor the Greeks' chief god, Zeus.

sentences.japanese: それは富士山の麓にある。
sentences.english: It is located at the foot of Mt. Fuji.

sentences.japanese: 山の麓に日が昇るが早いかただ一人山を登り始めた。
sentences.english: The sun had barely risen at the foot of the mountain when she set out alone up the slope.
